app.name: Dusk
app.brief: A calm app for sleep, meditation, and a daily morning ritual. Soft, dark, gentle, breathing.

direction.seed: a calm app for sleep meditation and a daily morning ritual soft dark gentle breathing dusk

thesis: The app is a ritual: one clear sequence, a calm pace, and visible progress without pressure.
summary: A dark sanctuary: a breathing circle, minimal text, and slow motion.
treatment: Near-black surfaces, a single soft accent, a large circular timer, and almost no chrome.

why.note: The brief strongly matches Ritual. The layout, type, and surface decisions come from that family rather than from a generic template.

css.display: 'New York', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Palatino Linotype', Palatino, Georgia, serif
css.body: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
css.numeric: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif

principles: Calm does not mean low contrast.
The next action is always obvious.
avoid: A dashboard of rings and invented streaks.
Tiny gray text that disappears in sunlight.
A paywall before the first useful session.
signatureMoves: A breathing ring that fills with the day.
A progress bar segmented by week.
A single handwritten note in the margin.

platform.ios: Use a large title but keep the chrome quiet. Prefer a single primary action and a tab bar for two or three peers. Use sheets for check-ins. Respect reduce motion and Dynamic Type. Haptics only on completion.
platform.android: Edge-to-edge with a soft surface and a compact top app bar. Use a NavigationBar for two or three peers. Respect the system animation scale. Use 48dp targets and generous spacing.

screens.home: A centered daily ritual: one prompt, one progress indicator, and one primary action. Secondary practices sit below a rule.
screens.detail: A practice detail: what it is, how long, what you need, and one start action. Show the real duration.
screens.compose: A check-in or journal entry: one prompt, a generous text area, a mood control, and a save action that preserves the draft.
screens.profile: A calm history: current streak, recent sessions, and settings. No fake social comparison.

components.button: Large, soft, filled with the accent; secondary actions are text or outlined. Minimum 48dp/44pt.
components.list: Soft rows or cards with 20-28pt radius, no hard shadows. Use whitespace and a subtle tonal fill.
components.input: Comfortable line height, visible label, gentle validation, no aggressive red until submit.
components.navigation: Quiet top bar, two or three tabs, sheets for check-ins.
